verdict.rationale: gstack is a set of skills running inside AI coding agents. A root router skill "sends any gstack request to the right skill" (docs-18), and skills declare natural-language and voice trigger phrases such as "test the app" and "run QA" (docs-51). Other skills turn vague intent into executable specs (docs-21) or run whole pipelines like ship and autoplan from a single request (docs-3, docs-5). missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language routing works reliably, and documentation of how far plain-language requests replace explicit slash commands.
